# Annie Wright, LMFT

> A trauma-informed therapy and coaching practice specializing in relational trauma recovery for high-achieving women, led by LMFT and EMDR-certified clinician Annie Wright.

Annie Wright offers one-on-one therapy, executive coaching, online courses, and speaking engagements for ambitious professionals seeking to heal relational trauma and regulate their nervous systems. Her practice is licensed across 14 states and features a signature "Fixing the Foundations" approach to trauma recovery.

## Core Services

- [One-on-One Therapy Services](https://anniewright.com/work-one-on-one-with-annie): One-on-one therapy services for high-achieving women, licensed in 14 states
- [Relational Trauma Recovery Therapy](https://anniewright.com/therapy-with-annie): Relational trauma recovery therapy using EMDR for high-achieving women
- [Online Therapy for Women](https://anniewright.com/online-therapy-for-women): Online therapy for women, licensed in 14 states across the US
- [Executive Coaching](https://anniewright.com/executive-coaching): Trauma-informed executive coaching for high-achieving professionals

## Signature Programs & Courses

- [Fixing the Foundations](https://anniewright.com/fixing-the-foundations): Signature program: Fixing the Foundations approach to healing relational trauma
- [Overcoming Relational Trauma Course](https://anniewright.com/overcoming-relational-trauma-course): Online course: Fixing the Foundations signature approach to trauma healing
- [Decade of Decisions](https://anniewright.com/decade-of-decisions): Program or offering related to decision-making for ambitious women
- [Strong and Stable Community](https://anniewright.com/strong-and-stable): Strong and Stable premium community for relational trauma recovery
